resources.name: Dexa Presence API
resources.description: WFH attendance + HRD monitoring API. Endpoints from docs/api-contracts.md

resources.name: Auth
resources.description: Login stores the JWT into admin_token / employee_token automatically.

resources.name: Login (Admin)
resources.description: Stores accessToken -> admin_token and employee.id -> admin_id

resources.name: Login (Employee)
resources.description: Stores accessToken -> employee_token and employee.id -> employee_id

resources.name: Change Password (self)
resources.description: Self-service. After running, update employee_password to {{ _.employee_new_password }} to re-login.

resources.name: Employees
resources.description: Admin CRUD + self profile. Create stores id -> created_employee_id.

resources.name: List Employees (admin)
Get My Profile (self)
Create Employee (admin)
resources.description: Stores new id -> created_employee_id for update/delete.

resources.name: Update Employee (admin)
Upload Photo (self)
resources.description: Multipart field 'photo', <=2MB. Pick a file in the Body tab.

resources.name: Attendance
resources.description: Employee check in/out + summary; admin read-only view.

resources.name: Check In (Masuk)
Check Out (Pulang)
Summary (self, tz-aware)
resources.description: Default: start of month -> today. Add from/to=YYYY-MM-DD to filter.

resources.name: All Attendance (admin, read-only)
Notifications (SSE)
resources.description: Long-lived server-sent events stream. Keep it open, then trigger a PATCH in another request.

resources.name: Profile Updated Stream
resources.description: event: profile.updated arrives whenever an employee profile is edited.
